lead_headline: Dumplin' closes Wednesday after 18 months as Mojo-99 Burgers shuts down in Westminster

restaurant.blurb: 2 new leads today: Dumplin' (Highlands fusion restaurant closing tomorrow after 1.5 years), Mojo-99 Burgers (Westminster family burger spot shuttered mid-April after 5 years).
